name: owner_truth_memory_search_embedding_jobs
summary: Adds durable current-SearchDocument embedding jobs with checkpoint, model, retry and lease fences; formal memory remains unaffected if vector work is disabled or retries.
operations: create current SearchDocument embedding backfill job table and claim index
validate job scope/hash/checkpoint before queue mutation
allow derived vector retry without re-writing MemoryVersion
rollback: Disable ownerTruthMemorySearchEmbedding worker and retain derived jobs/vectors for forensic and forward-compatible cleanup. Do not delete or rewrite formal memories.
